Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-colour gold-leaf body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 4 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 29% of the way down her figure from the top, about 63% of the way down her figure from the top and about 78% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries applied BRIGHT SILVER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright BRIGHT SILVER sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied TURQUOISE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright TURQUOISE sheen filling every gap. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied SAPPHIRE BLUE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright SAPPHIRE BLUE sheen filling every gap. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries applied EMERALD GREEN metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright EMERALD GREEN sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
